repo_notes.content: Nulang is a distributed, actor-based programming language written in Rust (single crate). Key subsystems: (1) compiler frontend: lexer -> parser -> typechecker (Algorithm W HM inference + row-polymorphic effects + Pony capabilities) -> effect checker -> HIR -> MIR -> bytecode in src/; (2) register-based bytecode VM + Cranelift JIT tiering in src/vm.rs and src/jit/; (3) multi-threaded actor runtime with work-stealing scheduler, ORCA GC, supervision trees, CRDTs, distribution over TCP in src/runtime/; (4) WASM backend (MIR->wasm-encoder) + Wasmtime host in src/mir_wasm.rs and src/wasm_runtime.rs; (5) AOT native backend via Cranelift in src/aot/; (6) AI runtime (LLM providers, memory, pipelines, debates, supervisor teams) in src/ai/; (7) LSP server in src/lsp/; (8) PyO3 Python interop in src/python/; (9) C FFI in src/ffi/; (10) libsql/Turso persistence in src/runtime/persistence.rs; (11) nula package manager in src/package/; (12) format-stability layer (frozen .nbc bytecode, NUL0 wire protocol, migration registry) in src/format/. AGENTS.md is the authoritative architecture reference. SPEC2.md is the language specification. There is no async/await in the VM or runtime -- concurrency is crossbeam deques + std::sync + raw unsafe pointers for ORCA GC. The only async surfaces are main.rs (#[tokio::main]), the LSP server, and the AI LLM client.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: High-level architecture: compiler pipeline (AST -> HIR -> MIR -> bytecode), register VM + Cranelift JIT, multi-threaded work-stealing actor runtime, distribution model, WASM/AOT backends. Reference AGENTS.md and SPEC2.md.

pages.title: Compiler Pipeline
pages.purpose: Lexer -> Parser -> TypeChecker (HM + effects + capabilities) -> EffectChecker -> CapabilityAnalyzer -> HIR lowering -> MIR lowering -> MIR codegen -> bytecode. Document the MIR-exclusive pipeline and all three backends (bytecode VM, WASM, AOT native). Reference src/lexer.rs, src/parser.rs, src/typechecker.rs, src/effect_checker.rs, src/hir_lower.rs, src/mir_lower.rs, src/mir_codegen.rs.

pages.title: Type System
pages.purpose: Hindley-Milner Algorithm W inference with row-polymorphic records and effects, and Pony-inspired reference capabilities (iso/trn/ref/val/box/tag/lineariso) with subtype lattice and at-most-once LinearIso consumption. Reference src/typechecker.rs, src/types.rs, src/effect_checker.rs.

pages.title: Bytecode VM & JIT
pages.purpose: Register-based VM with 256 registers per frame, i64-tagged NaN-boxed values, 135 opcodes across 18 groups. Cranelift JIT tiering with HOT_THRESHOLD=1000, typed compilation via TypeMetadata, SIMD auto-vectorization for element-wise loops. Reference src/vm.rs, src/bytecode.rs, src/value_layout.rs, src/jit/.

pages.title: Actor Runtime
pages.purpose: Multi-threaded work-stealing executor (Chase-Lev deques), ORCA garbage collection with incremental cycle detection, supervision trees, mailbox with selective receive, priority scheduling (High/Normal/Low), reduction-yielding scheduling, durable persistence (memory/JSON/SQLite). Reference src/runtime/.

pages.title: Distribution & CRDTs
pages.purpose: Location-transparent messaging over TCP (NUL0 wire protocol), gossip membership with incarnation-based conflict resolution, remote spawn, 8 CRDT types (GCounter, PNCounter, GSet, ORSet, AWORSet, LWWRegister, MVRegister, RGA) with delta-state replication. Reference src/runtime/network.rs, src/runtime/cluster.rs, src/runtime/distributed.rs, src/runtime/crdt.rs, src/runtime/crdt_reg.rs, src/runtime/crdt_manager.rs.

pages.title: WASM & AOT Backends
pages.purpose: WASM backend: MIR -> WASM via wasm-encoder, Wasmtime host runtime with guard pages, Cranelift inlining, SIMD, and AOT compilation via `wasmtime compile`. AOT native backend: MIR -> Cranelift CLIF -> native object code using compile-time type metadata for unboxed operations. Reference src/mir_wasm.rs, src/wasm_runtime.rs, src/aot/, src/type_metadata.rs.

pages.title: AI Runtime
pages.purpose: Provider-agnostic LLM client (OpenAI, Ollama), episodic/semantic/procedural memory, agent pipelines, debates, supervisor teams. Non-blocking `perform LLM.ask` suspend/resume in actor bytecode behaviors via `LlmAsk` opcode and scheduler pump. Reference src/ai/.

pages.title: Effects & Capabilities
pages.purpose: Algebraic effects with row-polymorphic effect types (Koka-inspired). Handler stack, perform/resume/unwind semantics. Capability system: iso/trn/ref/val/box/tag/lineariso with subtype lattice and at-most-once LinearIso consumption tracked by CapabilityAnalyzer. Reference src/effect_checker.rs.

pages.title: Language Specification
pages.purpose: Syntax, semantics, standard library effects (IO, Timer, Signal, LLM, FS, Test, Actor, Workflow), format stability contract, and language versioning. Reference SPEC2.md, src/stdlib.rs, src/format/.
